milestones.label: Applications open for 2027 international graduate admissions
milestones.source_text: Shanghai Jiao Tong University's official 2027 international graduate guide says applications open on 5 November 2026.

milestones.label: Application deadline, Chinese Government Scholarship via the university (first round)
milestones.source_text: The official SJTU guide names 15 December 2026 as the first-round deadline for applicants seeking the Chinese Government Scholarship through the university.

milestones.label: Application deadline, Chinese Government Scholarship via the university (final)
milestones.source_text: The official SJTU guide names 15 February 2027 as the last date for the Chinese Government Scholarship through the university.

milestones.label: Application deadline, Shanghai Government Scholarship and SJTU Scholarships
milestones.source_text: The official SJTU guide names 31 March 2027 as the deadline for the Shanghai Government Scholarship and the SJTU Scholarships.

milestones.label: Application deadline, self-funded applicants
milestones.source_text: The official SJTU guide names 31 May 2027 as the deadline for self-funded applicants. The page gives no interview or result dates; results are viewed in the application system.
